notes: Complete, verbatim copy of Telerivet's official OpenAPI 3.1 document (API version 1.9.10), served from the API itself — 171 operations and 122 component schemas: messages, broadcasts, contacts, groups, phones, projects, services, routes, scheduled messages, data tables, tasks, organizations and webhooks. openapi.json is the upstream with the x-openfn-adaptor stamp added. Replaces a 16 KiB hand-authored spec. Full coverage matters especially here: the telerivet adaptor exports no named operations at all, so every call a workflow makes goes through the generic builders. Refreshed 2026-11-16 from 1.9.9 to 1.9.10 (+3 operations, +1 schema).
